meta.title: Remove testing libraries from production environments
meta.body_summary: Rename two Go test utility files to _test.go and add a build tag to a DA mock file to exclude testing libraries from production builds, targeting binary size reduction.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot renamed test files and added build tag to exclude testify, but maintainer closed PR because it didn't address the intended testcontainers-go dependency removal.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Extremely small change (3 lines added, two file renames). This tiny fix was closed because it did not address the core dependency removal goal of the linked issue.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer tac0turtle stated the issue's goal was to remove the testcontainers-go dependency, but this PR only renamed testify-related files and added a build tag, missing the target.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduced binary size by excluding test libraries (testify) from production builds.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR because it did not accomplish the intended dependency removal.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent misinterpreted the issue scope, focusing on testify exclusion rather than the targeted testcontainers-go dependency removal, illustrating a process-level requirement mismatch.

detection_detail.code_reading: tac0turtle reviewed the PR against the issue description and determined it failed to remove the required dependency.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or binary size measurement provided; only narrative claims of reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after maintainer identified the scope mismatch; no further fixes attempted.

core_change_summary.description: Renamed two Go files to _test.go suffix (block/test_utils.go → block/test_utils_test.go, execution/evm/test_helpers.go → execution/evm/test_helpers_test.go) and added //go:build test tag to da/internal/mocks/da.go. No removal of testcontainers-go dependency.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Renamed files had zero content changes; the only real diff is a 3-line build tag addition.
change_trajectory: Renamed test utility files to follow Go convention for test-only files.
Added build tag to da mock to exclude it from production builds.

review_signals.summary: Buf lint and build checks passed.
PR does not remove testcontainers-go dependency as requested in linked issue; goal of issue is to remove that specific library.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR addressing testify-related test exclusion.
Maintainer tac0turtle commented that the PR misses the mark; it does not remove the intended testcontainers-go dependency.
PR closed by maintainer with no subsequent modifications.
